title: Electronic reactivity and drug binding in doped cycloparaphenylenes: toward multifunctional platforms for biosensing and targeted drug delivery
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,13124-13134
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09445C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Noora B. Shwayyea, Mustafa K. Salman, Alaa M. Khudhair, Fouad N. Ajeel, Ali Ben Ahmed
DFT shows heteroatom-doped cycloparaphenylenes (CPPs) are tunable nanoplatforms. With hydroxyurea and thioguanine they enable rapid release for sensing or stronger binding for drug delivery; O-doped CPPs approach metallic behavior after adsorption.
